format.note: Triple round-robin: 8 clubs meet three times, 21 matches each. No split, no carried points.
Double round-robin, 18 matches each. Ten clubs from 2026-27 (it was eight).

boundaries.note: 2026-27 only: the top flight expands for 2027-28, so League 2's top two are promoted and no TFPL club is relegated. The standing rule is 1 up (League 2 champion) + 1 shared two-legged play-off (League 2 runner-up v TFPL 7th), and 1 down (TFPL 8th) + that same play-off.

conflicts.topic: No relegation from the 2026-27 top flight
conflicts.detail: The TFPL has eight clubs and normally relegates 8th directly and sends 7th to a play-off against the League 2 runner-up. For 2026-27 only, the CFA decided there would be no relegations because the league expands for 2027-28. A sim that always relegates the bottom club will be wrong for this season.

conflicts.topic: League 2 promotes two, not one plus a play-off
conflicts.detail: Because of the same expansion, the 2026-27 League 2 table marks 1st and 2nd as promoted (both green). The normal route is champion only, with the runner-up in the promotion/relegation play-off.

Our row says 10, which is right for 2026-27 (the league expanded from eight). The competition-format prose on the league page still describes eight clubs and 14 games; the 2026-27 season article (10 clubs, 18 games) is the correct source.
Below League 2 clubs enter through pre-season qualifiers and can withdraw (three clubs did not enter for 2026-27), so there is no bottom-club relegation to model.

notes: Season runs September to May (2026-27), so this is the season now in progress; final standings do not exist yet. Levels and sizes (8/10) match our rows. The 2026-27 top flight is a one-off: no relegation and two promotions from League 2, both due to the 2027-28 expansion (the new size is not stated in the source). League 2 teams are a mix of senior clubs, university sides and reserve sides (Kaohsiung Attackers Reserves, Hang Yuan Reserves, Sunny Bank Reserves); reserve sides can be promoted, unlike in most European pyramids. Cups and AFC competitions excluded.
